Steals emails for future spam campaigns
Drops additional payloads such as Cobalt Strike or other malware leading to ransomware attacks

Macros launch DLL using regsvr32.exe command
Connects to Command and Control server for further instructions or additional payload installation

Use of stolen email reply chains to increase trust and spread
User interaction to enable macros and copy files to trusted folders
